name: read-error
description: Read and parse a test failure error message to identify the failing test, the expected vs actual values, and the source file/line where the assertion failed. Extracts structured information from the error for root-cause analysis.

inputs.name: testOutput
inputs.description: The raw stdout/stderr output from the test runner.

outputs.name: analysis
outputs.description: Structured analysis containing: failingTestName, expectedValue, actualValue, sourceFile, sourceLine, errorType.

failureConditions.description: No failing tests in the output
failureConditions.signal: test output contains 'pass' and no 'fail' entries
no assertion error or stack trace found in the output
